name: Cyrus
overview: Scripture reveals that God sovereignly moved King Cyrus of Persia to issue a decree allowing the Jewish exiles to return to Jerusalem and rebuild the temple, fulfilling the prophetic word spoken through Jeremiah. Cyrus acknowledges that the LORD God of heaven has given him all the kingdoms of the earth and has charged him to build a house for God in Jerusalem. This divine orchestration highlights God's providential control over earthly rulers to accomplish His purposes for His people and His house.
